newsitem.title: UK: New BSkyB chief exec Booth a TV veteran.
newsitem.headline: New BSkyB chief exec Booth a TV veteran.

text.p: Mark Booth, who will become chief executive of British Sky Broadcasting Plc next January, has 17 years of experience in television around the globe.
Booth, who is 40 and comes from Kansas, is currently chief operating officer of JSkyB, the digital satellite TV venture which Rupert Murdoch's News Corp and its partners plan to launch early in 1998.
Booth has been in that job for less than six months, having previously headed News Corp's Foxtel Australian pay TV joint venture since November 1994.
Prior to joining Foxtel, Booth had been president of UIH Programming, head of Maxwell Entertainment and launched MTV Europe as its chief executive.
